en_before: Shop descriptions of straight or relaxed cuts can cover several widths. Ask for thigh, knee and hem widths to distinguish them from other designs. Falling straight from the hips differs from fitting the thighs then widening below. The women's trouser-shape styling hub helps identify the silhouette before choosing a formula.
